chapter: Band personalities, Duke's last years and the office
title: Duke's love of comfort
summary: Duke spent freely for steaks and suites, saying there is no point saving money.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Oh, he didn't care; as long as he had his comfort, he didn't care nothing about dollars. The dollars didn't mean nothing to him; he'd spend anything, only wanted his comfort. If he wanted a steak three inches high, give it to him and don't ask any questions. Anything -- a room or a suite, if it cost $50 a day, that's what I want. I want that.
Was he always like that? I know he was like that later.
He would always say he liked his comfort. He used to say there was no use trying to look out for the money you spend; you won't be living all your life, so you might as well enjoy it while you can.
Well, he always had the best he could get, and that's good.
